pages.text: Nyati Money Market Fund factsheet, issued by Moyo Asset Managers (SYN). Nyati Money Market Fund is a money market fund and its objective is to preserve capital and provide daily liquidity. The management fee of Nyati Money Market Fund is 2.2 percent per annum. The minimum initial investment in Nyati Money Market Fund is SYN Sh 5,000, and the minimum top-up is SYN Sh 1,000. Over the 12 months to 2026-09-30 Nyati Money Market Fund delivered an effective annual yield of 7.0 percent.

Withdrawals from Nyati Money Market Fund are paid within 1 business days. The main holdings of Nyati Money Market Fund are call deposits (45 percent), short-dated government paper (20 percent) and fixed deposits at licensed banks (10 percent). Bara Custodial (SYN) acts as trustee of Nyati Money Market Fund and holds its assets separately from the manager. Nyati Money Market Fund was launched in 2022 and is licensed by the SYN Capital Markets Authority. Past performance is not a guarantee of future results and the value of units can fall.
